Sissirat's Sissy Spitter
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Two-handed Crossbow
Class:  Ranger
Damage:  varies with item level

Sissirat's Sissy Spitter is a ranger two-handed crossbow.

This item is soulbound.

This rainbow is specific to Sissirat's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Intellect
  • + Poison Damage Resistance
  • + Poison Damage
  • + Mana Steal

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
